site.description: SaBrian Digital Solutions builds modern websites, custom software and business management systems for organisations in Uganda. Practical technology that streamlines operations and supports growth.
site.name: Mwebesa Brian

hero.subhead: I design and develop modern websites, custom software and digital solutions that help businesses streamline operations, improve efficiency and grow. From business websites to management systems, I turn ideas into practical technology solutions.

problem.title: Make your systems work for you.
problem.body: Off the shelf platforms often limit growth and cause disconnected workflows. I build custom digital infrastructure to fix this, writing code that connects systems and automates manual tasks.

services.title: My Services
services.body: I provide comprehensive digital solutions tailored to your business needs. I handle every part of your project, from design to deployment.

items.title: Website Development
items.body: Your website is often the first interaction a client has with your business. I build high-performance, accessible, SEO-ready websites with clean code and custom CMS functionality, giving you full control without breaking the layout.

items.title: API & Data Integration
items.body: Your software should not live in silos. I build middleware that connects your CRM, accounting software, and third-party services like Stripe, Xero, or Salesforce. I help you eliminate manual data entry and reduce human error.

items.title: Custom Business Software
items.body: Complex problems require robust solutions. I build secure, scalable web applications using modern frameworks like React, Next.js and TypeScript. I engineer for performance, security, and long-term maintainability.

items.title: Mobile App Development
items.body: Reach your customers (or staff) directly on their devices. I develop high-performance, cross-platform mobile applications. I deliver native-feeling apps for iOS and Android while reducing development and maintenance costs.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.body: Complex functionality fails if users cannot figure out how to use it. I design intuitive interfaces, wireframes, and prototypes that prioritize clarity and efficiency before a single line of code is written.

items.title: Cloud Hosting & Infrastructure
items.body: Modern software requires modern infrastructure. I manage secure cloud deployments, automated backups, SSL certificates, and server performance. I ensure your applications remain fast, reliable, and protected.

intro.label: Who I Am
intro.body: I'm Brian Mwebesa, a software developer passionate about building technology that solves real-world problems. I combine technical knowledge, creativity and problem-solving to develop practical digital solutions.

intro.label: What I Do
intro.body: I specialize in web development, custom software development, database management and business information systems. My focus is creating responsive, user-friendly and reliable solutions tailored to specific business needs.

intro.label: My Approach
intro.body: I believe technology should make business operations easier, not more complicated. I focus on understanding each client's needs, designing intuitive interfaces and developing systems that are secure, scalable and easy to maintain.

intro.label: My Mission
intro.body: My mission is to help individuals, startups and established businesses embrace digital transformation through affordable, effective and innovative technology solutions.

items.body: Whatever I'm writing, I treat it as if it were an enterprise application. Clean architecture that scales with your business.
Built the public site for Bwindi Community Hospital in Kanungu, bringing services, departments, news and appointment forms into one place.
Designed loan-management and hardware-store systems for Ugandan organisations, covering applicants, inventory, checkout, accounts and reporting.

projects.title: Some of my work
projects.subhead: A selection of websites, dashboards and business systems I've designed and built — from photography portfolios and learning platforms to loan management and e-commerce.

slides.title: Mek Elias — Photographer Portfolio
slides.label: Frontend · React + TypeScript
body: An immersive visual portfolio for Ugandan photographer and visual artist Mek Elias, designed to showcase fine-art photography, editorial work and creative direction through cinematic, media-first presentation.

Built with React 18, TypeScript and Vite, the site combines Tailwind CSS and Radix UI with a fullscreen hero slideshow, responsive masonry galleries, an accessible lightbox, category filtering and a validated inquiry form.

slides.title: Mwebesa Brian — Personal Portfolio
slides.label: Personal Portfolio
body: A personal portfolio for Mwebesa Brian, focused on UI/UX and product development. The site pairs a bold typographic hero with project galleries, an about section and a contact path, presenting selected work in a clear, confident layout.

slides.title: Bwindi Community Hospital
slides.label: Healthcare Website · Full-Stack
body: A responsive, server-rendered website for Bwindi Community Hospital in Kanungu, Uganda. It brings services, departments, education, community health, projects, team, news, gallery and contact pages together with a preserved archive of the hospital's published content and Supabase-backed appointment and contact forms.

slides.title: Junior AI — EdTech Platform
slides.label: Frontend · EdTech Platform
body: An interactive EdTech platform that introduces learners aged 11–16 to artificial intelligence, robotics and data science through gamified course tracks, peer showcases and parent resources.

Built with React, TypeScript and Vite, it includes multi-criteria course discovery, a community feed, a parent and educator resource centre, tiered pricing and a mobile-first interface styled with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI.

slides.title: Pearl Bridge — Loan Management
slides.label: Full-Stack Web App
body: A migration-lending dashboard for managing overseas applicants, travel stages, SACCO loans, guarantors, repayments and portfolio reporting. Built with React, TanStack Start, TypeScript, Zod and Recharts, with typed workflow models, interest and repayment calculations, validated forms and in-memory demo data.

slides.title: FB General Hardware — E-commerce
slides.label: Full-Stack E-Commerce
body: A full-stack Next.js e-commerce platform for a Ugandan hardware store. It covers product browsing, category filtering, a persistent cart, checkout, Supabase authentication, account pages and a protected admin dashboard, backed by PostgreSQL schemas and transactional order creation.

slides.title: MRKT Edge — Landing
slides.label: Frontend · Market Intelligence
body: Landing page for MRKT Edge, a private market-intelligence terminal. Built with React 19, TanStack Start and strict TypeScript, it presents the product's risk-on/risk-off composite, bias cards, hand-drawn SVG charts and macro calendar with per-route SEO metadata.
slides.imageAlt: MRKT Edge market intelligence landing page

slides.title: MRKT Edge — Terminal
slides.label: Frontend · Market Terminal
body: The terminal itself: a single dark screen combining a risk-on/risk-off gauge, DXY sparkline, gold bias with confidence, event countdown, expandable asset bias cards, a 13-candle SVG chart, impact-scored headlines, COT positioning and the macro calendar.
